title: Senior Workday Integration Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**

  

As a Senior Workday Integration Consultant, you will provide technical leadership for the design, development, deployment, and optimization of enterprise Workday integrations across HCM, Financials, and Professional Services Automation (PSA). You will partner with business stakeholders, architects, and technical teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing integration solutions while driving modernization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the Workday landscape.

  

**What Will You Do:**

  

* Lead the design, development, deployment, and optimization of Workday inbound, outbound, and boomerang integrations across HCM, Financials, and PSA domains.
* Conduct integration workshops with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and design scalable integration solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
* Design and implement integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Cloud Connectors, Web Services APIs, middleware platforms, and Workday Extend capabilities.
* Manage and support Workday releases, enhancements, upgrades, and integration lifecycle activities while ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Provide advanced technical troubleshooting and resolution for complex integration, data, workflow, and platform issues.
* Lead, mentor, and guide Workday technical specialists while promoting knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with business, HR, Finance, PSA, and technology teams to ensure successful delivery of integration initiatives within scope, schedule, and quality expectations.
Manage integration roadmaps, RAID logs, status reporting, risk mitigation activities, and stakeholder communications across multiple projects and support engagements.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 8+ years of experience, including significant hands-on experience in Workday Integration development, support, and solution delivery.
* Deep expertise in Workday Integration technologies, including Workday Studio, EIB, Web Services APIs, Cloud Connectors, PECI, Report Writer, and Enterprise Interface design.
* Strong experience with Workday Business Process Framework, Configurable Security, Calculated Fields, and Workday reporting solutions.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting Workday Extend applications, workflows, integrations, and custom business solutions.
* Strong integration experience using XML, XSLT, Web Services, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware solutions such as Informatica, and enterprise integration technologies.
* Experience supporting Workday HCM, Financials, and Professional Services Automation (PSA) integrations within complex enterprise environments.
* Proven experience leading integration projects, managing stakeholders, conducting workshops, troubleshooting critical production issues, and driving successful delivery outcomes.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams.  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Knowledge and experience with Workday Orchestrate for workflow automation and integration orchestration.
* Experience designing integrations across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise application ecosystems using modern integration architectures.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices.
* Certification in Workday Integration, Workday Extend, or related Workday technical specializations preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, along with certifications in Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is highly desirable.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Team Lead – Technical Documentation
description:
**Position Summary:**

The Team Lead – Technical Documentation is responsible for leading a team of technical writers and documentation specialists in the creation, maintenance, and delivery of high-quality customer and engineering documentation. The role ensures adherence to documentation standards, project schedules, quality requirements, and continuous process improvements while collaborating with global engineering and project teams.

**Work You’ll Do:**

* Lead and mentor a team of technical writers and documentation specialists.
* Plan, assign, and monitor documentation activities to ensure on-time delivery of project documentation.
* Review and approve technical documents for accuracy, consistency, quality, and compliance with company standards.
* Coordinate with engineering, project management, manufacturing, service, and product experts to gather and validate technical information.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives in documentation processes, templates, tools, and workflows.
* Support resource planning, workload balancing, and project prioritization.
* Track team performance, quality metrics, and project status, and provide regular updates to management.
* Support training, onboarding, and professional development of team members.
* Participate in documentation tool evaluations, content management initiatives, and digital transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with documentation standards, customer requirements, and internal quality processes.  

**Team:**

Technical Documentation

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Technical Communication, or a related discipline.
* 6–10 years of experience in technical documentation
Minimum 2 years of experience leading or mentoring a team.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of technical documentation principles and structured authoring concepts.
* Experience creating operation manuals, maintenance manuals, spare parts catalogs, installation guides, and customer documentation.
* Knowledge of XML/DITA-based authoring environments and Content Management Systems (CMS/CCMS).
* Experience with documentation tools such as TIM, Paligo, ST4, MadCap Flare, Adobe Experience Manager Guides, or similar platforms.
* Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to review technical content for accuracy, consistency, and compliance with documentation standards.
* Experience working with global engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted documentation, content reuse, and digital documentation solutions is an added advantage.
* Exposure to process improvement initiatives and documentation quality management.

**Who we are:**

Mold-Masters ( www.moldmasters.com ) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.

Hillenbrand ( www.hillenbrand.com ) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.

Additionally, Hillenbrand Inc. and our operating companies are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. title: Data Labeling Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** Data Labeling Specialist (In\-Office Contract)  
**Company:** Arijentek  
**Location:** Pollachi, India (On\-site)  
**Salary:** ₹2,40,000 to ₹4,80,000 per year (2\.4 LPA to 4\.8 LPA)  
**Job Type:** Contract  
**Working Hours:** Flexible schedule, maximum 50 hours per week

**About Us**

At Arijentek, we're not just labeling data, we're helping improve the technology people use every day. Our work creates the examples and feedback that make advanced systems more accurate, consistent, and useful.

**What You'll Do**

Evaluate outputs from AI models, text, images, video, and documents against detailed criteria. Assess quality, spot errors and inconsistencies, and write clear, well\-reasoned justifications for your judgments. Every evaluation you complete helps these systems perform better in the real world.

**Who We're Looking For**

People who write clearly, think critically, and can back up a judgment call with a clear explanation. This role suits people who've done work built around precise written evaluation, UI/UX design, graphic design, photography, video production, editorial or research work, or writing technical specs and requirements.

* Strong readers and writers with sound judgment
* Comfortable evaluating creative or technical work against a set of criteria
* Takes quality seriously and catches what others miss
* Can follow detailed written guidelines independently
* Able to commute to and work from our Pollachi office

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, completed or in progress
* Excellent written English: clear, precise, well\-organized
* Strong attention to detail
* At least 1 year of experience in a role built around evaluating or reviewing work against a standard (e.g., UI/UX design, graphic design, photography, video production, editorial, research, QA, or technical writing). Equivalent experience will be considered.

**Technical Requirements**
